(CH3)2CH–CH2–CH3

review.keySource: NTA final answer key, NEET (UG) 2025, Code 45 (neet-sources/neet-papers/2025/nta-final-answer-key-code-45.pdf)

en.q:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): [an n-alkyl iodide, bond-line structure] undergoes SN2 reaction faster than [the corresponding n-alkyl chloride]
Reason (R): Iodine is a better leaving group because of its large size.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

review.keySource: NTA final answer key, NEET (UG) 2025, Code 45 (neet-sources/neet-papers/2025/nta-final-answer-key-code-45.pdf)
review.note: The two haloalkanes are bond-line drawings in the paper; transcribe the exact structures from the booklet.
